title: 第3277章 欧阳红玉回归江云市第3276章 生命精华救人
slug: 伏天鼎第3279章电话沟通误会
content_zh:
“嘿，你怎么开车的？没看到有人滑下来？不会躲开？”
凤梧桐吃痛，朝着驾驶室的张勇不满地吼道。
后排车窗落下，他看到秦伏天的脸，表情立刻一百八十度大转变。
“兄弟！恩人！原来是你呀！
快快，载我一程，等我回到凤家，一定让我爷爷好好感谢你！”
凤梧桐说着，一把拉开门，高兴地挤了进去。
他注意到，跟秦伏天坐在一起的，是个长相清纯的漂亮女孩，前方副驾驶坐的又是另一个容貌大气艳丽的美女。
所谓恩人之妻不可欺，为了避免冒犯到秦伏天，他果断决定跟秦伏天挤一挤。
等到车辆再次启动，凤梧桐无视掉张勇和方淼淼好奇的目光，感激地朝秦伏天道：
“兄弟，我们这次有五个人逃了出来，运气属实不错，多亏了你啊。
要不是你仗义相助，我就要被那群狗娘养的夺舍了。”
好不容易死里逃生，凤梧桐看起来像是有一堆脏话想骂，忍不住念念叨叨。
“龙婆谷天天装的与世无争，暗地里居然跟黑蛇会搅和到了一起，害得老子吃了这么大的亏。
等我回去之后，一定会揭穿他们的阴谋，将他们所有人一网打尽！”
方淼淼猛地回过头来，惊讶地问：“夺舍？什么夺舍？”
凤梧桐诧异地看了方淼淼一眼，将他遭遇的事情，以及秦伏天救人的事情，大致说了一遍。
他最后又道：“秦兄弟，南塔娜那个女人也跑了，你不用再去清盛帮她传话。
那个女人心思多，不可信，她说联系上你，你最好不要私下跟她见面。”
秦伏天微微点头，并不在意。
他对那个女人同样没什么好感，只是在救人的时候，顺带把她救下来了而已。

秦伏天特意使用追踪法术，指挥张勇找到凤梧桐，是因为另一件更重要的事情。
“凤梧桐，你们凤家有没有一个名叫凤瑶光的人？”
凤梧桐仔细想了想，摇了摇头：“我认识的这几个支脉中没有，但不知道本家那边的情况。兄弟，你找她有什么事情？”
秦伏天说道：“她是我妻子。”
听到这话，凤梧桐、方淼淼和张勇忍不住都看了过来。
妻子，凤家女儿，失踪等等信息在他们脑中旋转，听起来就很有故事。
凤梧桐一拍大腿：“难道是哪个老不死的棒打鸳鸯，将嫂子夺走了？我们凤家居然有这么不长眼的人？”
他当即表示：“秦兄弟，你放心，只要人还在我凤家，我就一定能找出来。
等找到嫂子，我亲自护送嫂子回到你身边！”
秦伏天明白凤梧桐误会了。
但他自己都还没弄清楚，如今他到底是第三次转世重修，还是遭遇了某种特殊的力量，无法向其他人解释这件事。
他只能说道：“没有什么棒打鸳鸯，你如果找到了人，直接跟我联系即可，千万不要擅自行动。”
秦伏天可还记得，凤瑶光并没有找到轮回石，找回前世的记忆，只听秦伏天描述过他们之间的故事。
如今状态重新倒转，秦伏天无法确定凤瑶光是否还记得他。
content_en:
"Hey, how did you drive? Didn't you see someone sliding down? Didn't you know how to avoid it?"
Feng Wutong was in pain and shouted dissatisfied at Zhang Yong in the cab.
When the rear window rolled down, he saw Qin Futian's face, and his expression immediately changed 180 degrees.
"Brother! Benefactor! It turns out to be you!
Come on, give me a ride. When I get back to Feng's house, I will let my grandpa thank you! "
Feng Wutong said, opened the door and squeezed in happily.
He noticed that the person sitting with Qin Futian was a beautiful girl with an innocent appearance, and the passenger seat in front was another beautiful girl with a magnificent appearance.
It is said that a benefactor's wife should not be bullied. In order to avoid offending Qin Futian, he decisively decided to squeeze in with Qin Futian.
When the vehicle started again, Feng Wutong ignored the curious looks of Zhang Yong and Fang Miaomiao, and gratefully said to Qin Futian:
"Brother, five of us escaped this time. We were really lucky, thanks to you.
If it weren't for your generous help, I would have been killed by those sons of bitches. "
After finally escaping from death, Feng Wutong seemed to have a lot of curse words that he wanted to curse and couldn't help mumbling them.
"Luang Phor Gu pretends to be aloof from the world every day, but secretly gets involved with the Black Snake Society, causing me to suffer such a big loss.
When I go back, I will definitely expose their conspiracy and catch them all in one go! "
Fang Miaomiao turned around suddenly and asked in surprise: "Seize the house? What seize the house?"
Feng Wutong glanced at Fang Miaomiao in surprise, and roughly told him what happened to him and Qin Futian's rescue.
He finally said: "Brother Qin, that woman Nantana has also run away, you don't need to go to Chiang Saen to deliver messages to her.
That woman has many thoughts and is not trustworthy. She said that if she contacts you, you'd better not meet her in private. "
Qin Futian nodded slightly and didn't care.
He also didn't have a good impression of that woman, but he just saved her by the way when he was rescuing people.
Qin Futian specifically used tracking spells to direct Zhang Yong to find Feng Wutong because of another more important matter.
"Feng Wutong, is there anyone named Feng Yaoguang in your Feng family?"
Feng Wutong thought about it carefully and shook his head: "I don't know any of these branches, but I don't know the situation in my family. Brother, what do you want to see her for?"
Qin Futian said: "She is my wife."
Hearing this, Feng Wutong, Fang Miaomiao and Zhang Yong couldn't help but look over.
Information about the wife, the Feng family daughter, and the disappearance were swirling in their minds, and it sounded like a story.
Feng Wutong slapped her thigh: "Is it some old man who beats the mandarin ducks with a stick and took away my sister-in-law? Are there really such short-sighted people in our Feng family?"
He immediately said: "Brother Qin, don't worry, as long as he is still in our Feng family, I will definitely find him.
When I find my sister-in-law, I will personally escort her back to you! "
Qin Futian understood that Feng Wutong had misunderstood.
But he himself has not yet figured out whether he has been reincarnated for the third time or has encountered some special power. He cannot explain this to others.
He could only say: "There is no such thing as beating a mandarin duck. If you find someone, just contact me directly. Don't act without authorization."
Qin Futian still remembers that Feng Yaoguang did not find the reincarnation stone and retrieve the memories of his past life. He only heard Qin Futian describe the story between them.
Now that the situation has reversed again, Qin Futian is not sure whether Feng Yaoguang still remembers him.
